info.name: Guardhouse Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Guardhouse Backend.

**Setup:**
1. Set `baseUrl` (default: http://localhost:8080)
2. Call **Auth > Login** and copy the `token` from response
3. Set collection variable `token` (or use Tests tab to auto-save)

**Auth:** Use header `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` for protected routes.

item.name: Auth
item.description: User authentication: signup, login, forget/reset password, logout, get users.

request.description:
**Request:** name, email, password, role, phone (required). Optional: companyId, createdBy. Role must be: SUPER_ADMIN | ADMIN | MANAGER | STAFF.

**Response 201:** `{ message, user: { id, name, email, role, phone, companyId, createdBy } }`

**Request:** email, password.

**Response 200:** `{ message, token, id, email, name }` — Save `token` in collection variable for other requests.

item.name: Company
item.description: Company register/login, SuperAdmin actions, Holidays, Skills, Compliance, Role Templates, Documents, Data Import, Site Positions.

request.description:
**Request:** companyName, companyEmail, ContactInfo, address, registrationNumber, plan (all required). Plan must be: BASIC | STANDARD | ENTERPRISE.

**Response 201:** `{ message, data, status }`

**Request:** companyEmail, password.

**Response 200:** `{ message, token, id, companyEmail, companyName }`

**Path:** id = company _id.
**Request:** status = PENDING | ACTIVE | REJECTED.

**Response 200:** `{ message, data }`

**Path:** status = ACTIVE | REJECTED | PENDING.

**Response 200:** `{ message, companies }`

**Query:** country, state, year (optional).

**Response 200:** `{ message, count, data }`

**Request:** description, date (ISO, required). Optional: startTime, endTime (HH:mm), country, state, year.

**Response 201:** `{ message, data }`

**Request:** name (required). Optional: description, isActive.

**Response 201:** `{ message, data }`

item.name: Customer
item.description: Customer CRUD and status. All routes require Authorization: Bearer {{token}}.

request.description:
**Request:** customerName (required). Optional: customerReferenceNumber, ReferenceId, Address, city, zipCode, country, invoiceRemainder, Contact[].

**Response 201:** `{ message, data, status }`

**Path:** status = active | inactive.

**Response 200:** `{ message, count, customers }`

**Path:** id.
**Request:** status = Active | Deactive.

**Response 200:** `{ message, customer }`

**Path:** id = customer _id.
**Request:** firstName, lastName, email (required). Optional: staticSites[], patrolSites[], defaultReports[], specificIncidentReports[], frequency.

**Response 201:** `{ message, data, status }`

item.name: Customer Site
item.description: Customer site data retrieval. Base path: /api/customer/site. All routes require Authorization: Bearer {{token}}.

request.description:

**Response 200:** `{ message, data: { customer, staticSites, patrolSites, reports } }`

**Path:** customerName.

**Response 200:** `{ message, data: { customerName, title, sites[], totalCount, activeCount } }`

**Path:** customerName.

**Response 200:** `{ message, data: { customerName, title, sites[], totalCount, activeCount } }`

item.name: Get All Customer Portals by Status (Site)

request.description:

item.name: Site
item.description: Sites and site contacts. Base path: /api/site.

request.description:
**Path:** customerId = customer _id.
**Request:** siteName (required). Optional: siteReferenceNumber, referenceId, address, state, zipCode, country, mobileNumber, welfarecheckInterval, holidayCalender, mobileClockTime, welfareChecks[] (day: monday..sunday, startHours, toHours).

**Response 201:** `{ message, data }`

**Path:** siteId = site _id.
**Request:** firstName, lastName, emailAddress, mobileNumber, contactType, notes.

item.name: Mobile Patrol
item.description: Regions, Patrol Sites, Runsheets. Base: /api/mobile-patrol. Auth: Bearer {{token}}.

request.description:
**Query:** customerId, regionId, status (optional).

**Response 200:** `{ message, count, data }`

**Request:** customerId, regionId, name (required). Optional: siteDetails, portalSchedule, alarmContacts, siteDocuments, siteCodesAndInstructions, locationCheckpoints, incidentReportConfig, status.

**Response 201:** `{ message, data }`

**Request:** name (required). Optional: regionId, defaultRun, runsheetStart, runsheetEnd, days (MON–SUN), patrolSites[].

**Response 201:** `{ message, data }`

item.name: Staff
item.description: Employees, HR Notes, Compliance Requests, Manager Site Assignment, Submitted Compliance. Base: /api/staff. Auth: Bearer {{token}}.
